step: Step 4 - Trip-level feature engineering for driver behaviour analysis
source_layer: processed/analytical/ (Step 3 certified output; not re-derived from Excel)
protected_file_hash_check: unchanged before/after run for all Step 2/3 outputs + Excel

thresholds.harsh_event_delta_kmph_justification: 90th percentile of |minute-to-minute speed change| across 12537 valid consecutive-minute pairs in the current telemetry layer (recomputed p90 = 25.4 km/h). Chosen instead of the existing Step 3 speed_jump_kmph=50.0 threshold because that value is calibrated as a rare data-quality outlier flag (0.37% of deltas exceed it), not a driver-behaviour signal; 25.4 is well below 50.0 so the two concepts do not overlap and no existing Step 3 rule is redefined.
thresholds.high_speed_kmph_justification: 90th percentile of instantaneous Speed_kmph across the current telemetry layer (recomputed p90 = 37.4 km/h). No approved behavioural speed threshold exists in Step 2/3 documentation - only the speed_min/speed_max=[0,90] plausibility validity range, which no observed reading approaches (max observed 73.6 km/h) and is therefore not usable as a behavioural cutoff. This is a fleet-relative statistic, not a claim of exceeding a legal or posted speed limit (no such field exists in the source data).

trip_distance_km.note: Distance_KM documented as approximate; disagrees with speed-integral on 243/450 trips per Step 3 validation (flag_distance_vs_speed_integral). Not recomputed here.

harsh_accel_events.formula: count of rows where Speed_kmph[t]-Speed_kmph[t-1] > 25.4, ordered by Timestamp within Trip_ID
harsh_accel_events.reason: p90 of |Δspeed| fleet-wide; below existing 50 km/h/min Step 3 data-quality threshold

speed_delta_mean_kmph.formula: mean(|Δspeed|) over trip's valid minute-to-minute deltas (reuses Step 3 telemetry.speed_delta_kmph)

stop_count.formula: count of distinct runs of Speed_kmph==0 minutes, ordered by Timestamp

stop_duration_min.formula: count of Speed_kmph==0 minutes (1 row = 1 minute)

telemetry_flagged_minute_pct.formula: 100 * (rows with any of 7 existing telemetry flags=1) / telemetry_row_count

any_trip_quality_flag.formula: logical OR of the 7 existing trip-level flags

optional_high_speed_time_pct.reason: p90 of instantaneous Speed_kmph fleet-wide; no approved speed-limit field exists
optional_high_speed_time_pct.status: optional/exploratory - not a legal-limit violation claim

optional_accel_mag_mean_g.status: optional/exploratory - single per-minute snapshot, uncalibrated axis orientation

optional_gyro_mag_mean_dps.status: optional/exploratory - cannot isolate cornering from noise at 1 sample/min with unknown mount orientation

optional_features_exclusion_reason: Telemetry captures one accelerometer/gyroscope snapshot per minute from an uncalibrated phone mount (orientation not documented anywhere in the source workbook), so IMU-based features cannot reliably represent driver behaviour events at this grain. They are retained only as exploratory/optional columns, clearly prefixed optional_, and should not be used in any primary driver-behaviour scoring (Step 5+) unless a higher-frequency, orientation-calibrated IMU stream becomes available.

features_excluded_entirely.cornering_turning_severity: Not computed. Requires known IMU axis-to-vehicle mapping and sub-second sampling; neither is available (see Step 4 Phase 1 inspection).
features_excluded_entirely.true_speeding_violation: Not computed as a rule violation. No posted/legal speed-limit field exists in the source data; only the relative optional_high_speed_time_pct proxy is offered.

distance_km_caveat: Distance_KM is documented in the Data Dictionary as 'approximate, derived from per-minute speed', and Step 3 validation already found it disagrees with the actual speed integral on 243/450 trips (flag_distance_vs_speed_integral) and with GPS path on 36/450 trips (flag_distance_vs_gps). trip_distance_km is passed through unchanged and both flags are carried into driver_trip_features.csv; no new feature is built by dividing by this field.
notes: processed/*.csv (Step 2 files) were not read or modified.
Data/*.xlsx was not read or modified in this step.
